content: WhatsApp export format specifics: timestamps are local device time with NO timezone indicator (cannot reliably convert to UTC). Media filenames: IMG-/VID-/PTT- prefixes with YYYYMMDD-WAxxxx; date in filename reflects receive date not message date (can differ by a day near midnight). Documents keep original filename (spaces/special chars). 1:1 exports attribute own messages to 'You'; group exports show every sender name/number plus system lines without sender. Group name appears in ZIP filename and is used even if renamed later. Stickers/GIFs produce a placeholder but the actual file is rarely reliably referenced in txt.
